features.name: AI assisted performance analysis
features.description: Each page in the performance report now has AI assistance with generated summaries, key insights, and analysis to help identify performance issues.
caveats: requires sufficient data variety for useful insights

features.name: Key influencers analysis
features.description: AI visual that analyzes performance data to pick up patterns and identify performance regressions across applications, allowing users to investigate further.

features.name: Top segments analysis
features.description: AI segmentation analysis that clusters data and presents patterns in different segments, allowing users to filter and investigate specific performance issues.

features.name: Decomposition tree analysis
features.description: AI-assisted root cause analysis using decomposition trees that suggests high or low values influencing page load times and other metrics to help identify performance bottlenecks.

features.name: Top 10 slowest pages report
features.description: Convenience feature showing the top 10 most urgent performance issues in both tabular and graph form for quick identification of performance problems.

features.name: API queuing telemetry
features.description: Telemetry tracking for API calls showing how much time an API call spent in the server queue, helping identify queuing delays for O-Data and API calls.

features.name: Long running AL telemetry - total and exclusive time
features.description: Telemetry now includes both total and exclusive time for long running AL code, allowing users to filter out time spent in modal dialogues and see tuning potential.

features.name: Long running AL SQL statistics
features.description: SQL statistics now included in long running AL telemetry to help identify whether performance issues are due to long-running SQL operations.

features.name: Job queue entry description telemetry
features.description: Job queue performance reports now include job queue entry descriptions in telemetry, providing a hierarchy view by object name, ID, type, and description.

features.name: Report performance telemetry
features.description: Telemetry now tracks report generation performance including dataset generation time and report rendering time to help diagnose report performance issues.

features.name: Web service error troubleshooting guides
features.description: Improved error telemetry for web services with new troubleshooting guides in documentation for HTTP status codes, supporting identification and resolution of web service errors.

features.name: HTTP status code filtering and visuals
features.description: Improved filtering on HTTP status codes with visuals showing errors in incoming web service requests based on status codes, integrated with troubleshooting guides.

features.name: User agent support for web service calls
features.description: User agent tracking for web service calls allows identification of which client is making the call, helping troubleshoot issues specific to particular web service clients.
caveats: user agent must be set when calling Business Central

features.name: Web service exceptions and diagnostics
features.description: Web service telemetry now includes server exceptions, diagnostics messages, and AL call stack to help developers troubleshoot web service issues more effectively.

features.name: Web service metadata error isolation
features.description: From version 22.X, web service metadata errors only fail the specific service calls with metadata problems instead of failing the entire web service stack for an environment.

features.name: Outgoing web service error filtering
features.description: Outgoing web service pages now have improved filtering on status codes and new visuals showing status codes based on endpoint use for better error diagnosis.

features.name: Azure functions telemetry
features.description: Telemetry support for Azure functions usage and errors, with a supporting report to show errors and enable alerting for Azure function calls from AL code.

features.name: SMTP email error telemetry
features.description: New telemetry data from version 22.3 for SMTP email errors, reflected in the email error report to help troubleshoot and alert on email integration problems.

features.name: Non-retriable job queue exceptions reporting
features.description: New visuals and filtering to identify non-retriable job queue exceptions that cause the server to stop a job queue, helping find and fix job queue failures.

features.name: Job queue retry limit reporting
features.description: Job queue entries that exceed the maximum number of retries are now shown in the job queue error report, allowing users to identify and fix repeatable job queue failures.

features.name: Feature module lock error function enhancements
features.description: The lock error function in the feature module now shows AL code stack and top and bottom of the stack to help identify what code failed and where the failure occurred.

features.name: Error page no data indicator
features.description: When there is no data to show on error pages, a green banner appears stating no data is available to indicate successful status and rule out connectivity errors.

features.name: Change lock lifecycle events
features.description: Upcoming feature to provide notifications or events whenever a table or field is added or removed from change lock, allowing setup of alerts when telemetry is enabled on multiple items.
caveats: Likely within the next few months

features.name: Pending extensions validation signals
features.description: New UI validation signals for when administrators upload pending extensions directly in the client, allowing alerts on failed validations to help troubleshoot issues.

features.name: Pending extensions upgrade validation
features.description: Online service validates pending extensions against the next major version by attempting to compile them, providing telemetry on success or failure to alert on customers blocked from upgrading.
features.status_evidence_quote: we also in the service not on premises validate um pended extensions on environment against next major so we actually try to compile them

features.name: Business events telemetry coverage
features.description: Business events will have telemetry coverage in version 23, allowing monitoring of business events usage and errors.

features.name: Onboarding telemetry page and PowerBI follow-up
features.description: New onboarding signal page in Business Central with PowerBI follow-up capability to track and analyze environment onboarding starts and completions across all customers.

features.name: Administration report inventory page version tracking
features.description: Administration report inventory page now displays which major version of Business Central an app is installed on, helping ISVs see customer base versions and identify needed fixes.

features.name: Business Central Usage Analytics PowerBI app
features.description: Free PowerBI app available on AppSource providing insights into telemetry data including usage, errors, performance, and environment or app changes.
caveats: Requires PowerBI Pro license to consume and refresh

features.name: KQL walkthrough documentation
features.description: Documentation added under aka.ms/bc-telemetry with KQL walkthrough examples that guide users from basic to writing simple reports, making KQL more accessible.

features.name: PowerBI metrics alerting
features.description: No-code alerting approach using PowerBI metrics to set up scorecards for tracking certain metrics with Teams alerts, no developer involvement required.

features.name: Low-code KQL alerting
features.description: Low-code alerting using KQL expressed conditions with Power Automate, Logic Apps or other tools to set up automated alerts based on telemetry data.
